items.name: Cleburne Cubing Classic 2021
items.information: **This competition will be following unique precautions to protect competitors and spectators against COVID-19. By registering, you automatically consent to COVID restrictions. Please check COVID Safety tab for further details.** If COVID cases rise, we may need to cancel this competition; competitors will be notified by email in that case. Due to COVID-19 we are limiting **1 guest per competitor** - if you are able to attend by yourself we recommend not having guests. Due to COVID-19 we will not be accepting event changes during the competition - please request changes by Wednesday September 29th, 2021 7:00pm CDT. ***Please note that this schedule is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule.*** This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, ***all competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, you may want to look at CubingUSA's Competitor Tutorial.***

items.name: Rhein-Neckar Open A 2021

venue.name: Sonnbergschule
venue.details: On the first floor in the back, reachable through a metal staircase at the outside of the building.

items.information: Rhein-Neckar Open A 2021 is a one-day competition and series competition to Rhein-Neckar Open B 2021 which will be held one day later. **Please note that you can only compete in one of the two competitions.** If you register for both competitions, only the first registration will be valid and we will immediately delete the second (later) registration. Rhein-Neckar Open A 2021 ist eine Ein-Tages-Competition und Partner-Competition von Rhein-Neckar Open B 2021, die einen Tag später stattfinden wird. **Bitte beachte, dass du nur an einem der beiden Wettbewerbe teilnehmen kannst.** Wenn du dich für beide Wettbewerbe anmeldest, so zählt nur die erste Anmeldung und wir werden die zweite (spätere) Anmeldung unverzüglich löschen.

items.name: Sandnes Open 2021
items.information: **English:** Welcome to Sandnes Open 2021! The competition will use almost the same format as the Sandnes competitions from previous years, but this year there will be some fewer events. The competition is free to attend for everyone - even for the competitiors. If you're not part of this competition or accompanying a competitor, please refrain from coming to the competition so we can adhere to safety policies. **Norsk:** Velkommen til Sandnes Open 2021! Konkurransen vil ha ca samme format som de tidligere Sandnes-konkurransene, men i år er det noen færre grener. Konkurransen er gratis for alle - også for deltakere. Om du ikke er med i konkurransen eller følger med en deltager, vennligst la vær å møte opp slik at vi enklere kan holde avstand.
